description: Adsorption Energy of N2 on Co(001) Basal Surface (HCP P6_3/mmc, ferromagnetic, ISPIN=2, PBE)
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of N2 on the Co(001) HCP basal surface (P6_3/mmc). Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+N2) - E(slab) - E(N2).

references: Zhang, Chen, Liu, Su & Li, J. Phys. Chem. C 123, 10956-10966 (2019)
method.modeling: Ferromagnetic HCP Co(001) basal slab with at least 4 layers, vacuum >= 15 Angstrom, and a 3x3x1 or larger surface supercell; adsorb intact N2 end-on at an atop Co site. Reference Eads to the clean Co slab plus gas-phase singlet N2.

key_parameters.magnetism: ISPIN=2 for Co slab and slab+N2; FM Co initialization

method.rationale: Value is the associative molecular chemisorption energy for N2 on HCP Co(001) from Zhang et al. 2019, written in this benchmark's negative Eads convention and referenced to gas-phase N2. The source used spin-polarized VASP/PAW/PBE for intact N2 adsorbed end-on at an atop Co site. The benchmark uses an absolute tolerance of +/-0.20 eV. Co magnetism and the gas/slab spin split are part of the trap: use ferromagnetic Co slabs, but a closed-shell singlet N2 gas reference.
